correctness.rationale: The forest/special-vertex rank identity bounds the number of branching B vertices by a-1; Cayley bijection gives the exact leading term; the only a-2 cases are two-component A forests and a contracted size-three hyperedge, giving H_a. Fixed-a finite patterns bound all lower terms and prove the TV asymptotic. Exact independent brute and recurrence checks pass; finite checks corroborate rather than replace proof.
